risk_note: RV2 (settlement clawback + new orders column). FU-R9-REFUND-BASELINE (D10-814 ⑤ / D10-868 ② / D10-870 / D10-918): the clawback sync compared refunded_quantity with the credit-time refunded_quantity_at_credit, so after one return every later changed sync went to R9 again (a later negative settlement was posted as CLAWBACK / PART_REFUND with order.clawed_back instead of R10 SETTLE_ADJUST, and a content-only change reopened CLAWBACK_NO_COMMISSION pending rows). New nullable column orders.refunded_quantity_r9_baseline (no backfill; not live, staging rows take the old route once — migration comment); the increase now compares with COALESCE(baseline, at_credit, 0). settlement clawback is the only writer: casClawbackOrder (R8 / R9 / R10) advances it in the same statement; the positive-skip / no_change exits advance it with casRefundBaseline on the sync's own transaction (row_version CAS, CREDITED); waiting for the union commission does not advance it; the JD switch off (alert_only) still advances it. D10-918 ②: an R9 no_change that brought a new settlement record also closes the order's open CLAWBACK_NO_COMMISSION pending row on the same transaction (basis: 06_FUND BR-FUND-01 detail 「已处置退件数」, D10-870 — 「…下一条新结算记录仍按 R9 处理并关闭那张待处理」; an R9 with zero recomputed difference is still handled as R9, D10-919). growth invite reward and BR-TEXT-03 keep comparing at_credit. Migration number = main max + 1 at landing. No frozen test changed. Full verification is the required CI checks (approvals 21; AWS runners off, D10-555).

reviews.note: Codex money r1 pass with one S2 (an equal new settlement left the CLAWBACK_NO_COMMISSION pending row open) fixed in this task per D10-918 ② with rule tests attempt 2 (#11 #12) and implementation r2; money r2 pass, 0 findings (couli-runs/B2-04zzf/review-money-r1.saved.json, review-money-r2.json)

spec_test_review.note: rule tests by a fresh independent Claude through claude-run.sh (attempts 1–2; written before the ledger reached main, with a temporary trusted root = main + the orchestrator-checked ledger, as allowed in D10-870 / 23:21; hand-assembled brief, brief.ts over 24KB). Gate spec-test reviews by a fresh independent Claude (D10-848): r1 pass (S2: the baseline-only write must be on the sync transaction — implemented), r2 after attempt 2 (couli-runs/B2-04zzf/review-spec-r1.json, review-spec-r2.json). Red: 16 → 18 rule tests in 7 files red for the right reason; on the implementation the local container ran all 18 green. Both gate reviews carried the same S2 (no rule test fails if the baseline-only write or the pending close went through the pool instead of the sync transaction); the implementation writes both on the sync transaction (casRefundBaseline takes the sync trx; checked by Codex money r1 / r2).
